name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
summary: In the Searing Gorge, Taskmaster Scrange wants you to thin the competition through bloody work.

sections.title: An Open Position
sections.body: Taskmaster Scrange sends you through the gorge to kill fifteen Dark Iron Taskmasters and fifteen Dark Iron Slavers. Return when your clothes are bloody enough. You will know when that is, and you are not to ask.

faq.answer: Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge wants help culling the competition.
Kill fifteen Dark Iron Taskmasters and fifteen Dark Iron Slavers.

faq.q: How does Scrange tell the work is done?
faq.answer: Scrange judges by the state of your clothes, weighing you with them and without them to be sure.
